blocks.text:
After breakfast, the tour to Corcovado begins. From the station, the train travels through the Tijuca Forest, right inside the city. Along the way, you may see tropical vegetation, birds and animals.

At the summit, at an altitude of about 700 m, stands the 38-metre statue of Christ the Redeemer, built in 1931. The viewing platform offers another perspective on Rio, different from Sugar Loaf.

The route to the summit passes through Tijuca's dense vegetation, so the trip to one of the city's main landmarks also provides a brief introduction to the tropical forest. From above, the city unfolds through its ocean, beaches, bay and green slopes.

After the tour, return to the hotel and relax.
